description: Sample Q&A for EvalHub walkthrough. Run evaluations from the OpenShift AI Evaluations dashboard (EvalHub in redhat-ods-applications only).

items.question: What is the purpose of this demo application?
items.reference_answer: It demonstrates wiring a RAG chatbot to OpenShift AI components: OGX, MLflow, EvalHub, and Tempo.

items.question: How does the app store document embeddings?
items.reference_answer: Through the OGX Files and Vector Stores APIs; OgxServer indexes into its managed pgvector provider.

items.question: Does the application connect directly to Postgres?
items.reference_answer: No. The app never opens Postgres; pgvector stays behind OgxServer.

items.question: Where should EvalHub be deployed?
items.reference_answer: In the redhat-ods-applications namespace via the OpenShift AI dashboard.

items.question: Where do OpenTelemetry traces go?
items.reference_answer: To the RHOAI data-science collector and then Tempo.
